description: Large mixed-task inventory: 9 DistilBERT LoRA adapters across 5 task types. Tests large-inventory mode, region summaries, candidate-space maps, and the HTML report at scale.
trial_purpose: Test large-inventory ergonomics. Region summaries, candidate-space maps, and the HTML report should help navigate a 9-adapter / 36-pair candidate space.

adapters.notes: SST-2 binary sentiment. Same task family as IMDB but different dataset.
SST-2 binary sentiment (different author from above).
4-class news topic classification. Source model had prior emotion training.
Binary hate speech detection. Source model had prior CoLA training.
Binary hate speech detection (different training lineage from above).
4-class news topic classification. Source model had prior YAHD hate-detection training.

selection_rationale: 9 adapters across 4 task types on a single backbone. Produces 36 candidate pairs — well into large-inventory territory. Includes natural same-task clusters (IMDB pair, SST-2 pair, AG News pair, hate-speech pair), a related-task group (sentiment/emotion), and genuinely cross-task pairs (sentiment × news, hate × news). TransferGraph adapters have varied training lineage (different source pretraining), which tests whether Gradience detects lineage effects.

expected_gradience_behavior.regions: Should produce 3-4 distinct regions (sentiment cluster, news cluster, hate cluster, cross-task)
expected_gradience_behavior.same_task_safe_zones: IMDB pair, SST-2 pair, AG News pair, hate-speech pair
expected_gradience_behavior.cross_task_caution: Sentiment × news, hate × news, emotion × news
expected_gradience_behavior.large_inventory_mode: Should trigger region summaries and candidate-space map
expected_gradience_behavior.overall: Substantial reduction from 36 pairs to a smaller evaluate-first subset. HTML report should be the natural entry point.
